skill.name: gemini-research-subagent
skill.description: Delegates large-context code research to Gemini CLI for codebase analysis, bug tracing, architecture review, security review, and verification planning.
skill.summary: Uses Gemini CLI as a large-context research assistant before Claude, Codex, or Claude Code implements changes.
skill.author: DasBluEyedDevil

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown backtick false positives, but the command examples intentionally run a relative Gemini wrapper. The main concerns are untrusted relative script execution, possible source disclosure to Gemini CLI, and prompt injection through local role files.

remediation.suggestion: Package a trusted wrapper with the skill or call a verified absolute command path after explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Source and diff disclosure to Gemini CLI
remediation.suggestion: Add consent, redaction, and path allowlist guidance before sending directories, diffs, or bug details to Gemini.
Load only trusted role files and ignore `.gemini/roles/` from untrusted repositories unless the user approves them.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Relative Script Execution
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent to run `./skills/gemini.agent.wrapper.sh`, but the package only contains SKILL.md. A workspace can supply that relative script and execute arbitrary commands.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command path is relative and appears in multiple usage examples. The audited file structure shows no bundled wrapper script, so resolution depends on the caller workspace.

semantic_findings.title: Source Code Disclosure to External AI Service
semantic_findings.description: The examples pass source directories and diffs to Gemini CLI. That can disclose local code, secrets, or pending changes without a documented consent or redaction step.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands explicitly pass `@src/` and `--diff` into Gemini CLI. The exact upload behavior depends on Gemini CLI configuration, but the disclosure risk is clear.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Role Prompt Loading
semantic_findings.description: The skill says roles are loaded from `.gemini/roles/` and describes custom role files. Role files from an untrusted repository could inject instructions into Gemini research.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The role-loading path is documented, but the wrapper implementation is not included. The risk depends on whether role files are read from the analyzed workspace.

content.user_title: Delegate Code Research to Gemini CLI
content.value_statement: Large codebases are difficult to inspect within one assistant context. This skill delegates scoped research to Gemini CLI and returns structured findings for Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Runs documented Gemini CLI wrapper commands for directory, diff, bug, and verification research.
Offers role presets for review, debugging, planning, security, auditing, explanation, migration, documentation, dependency mapping, and onboarding.
Defines custom role naming patterns under `.gemini/roles/`.
Requests structured Gemini responses with summary, files, analysis, and recommendations.
Separates research, implementation, and verification steps in the workflow.
limitations: Requires Gemini CLI and a wrapper script that is not included in this package.
May expose source code or diffs to an external AI service.
Does not write code; the main assistant must implement changes.
Role quality depends on local `.gemini/roles/` files.

use_cases.title: Trace Complex Bugs
use_cases.description: Developers can ask Gemini to inspect related files before changing code in Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.

use_cases.title: Plan Architecture Changes
use_cases.description: Technical leads can collect cross-file context before approving a multi-component implementation plan.

use_cases.title: Review Security Risks
use_cases.description: Security reviewers can request broad codebase analysis before deciding what the main assistant should fix.

prompt_templates.title: Ask for Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gemini research subagent to summarize the main modules related to this feature before I edit anything.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Bug
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gemini with the debugger role to trace why this behavior happens across the relevant files. Return files, cause, and fix options.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gemini with the planner role to propose an implementation plan for this multi-file change. Include risks, sequencing, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Verify
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gemini with the security role to review this area, then use the verify template after I make changes. Flag data exposure risks.

output_examples.input: Request: Analyze a login failure that appears across API, session, and client code.
output: Summary identifies session expiry as the likely cause.
Files section lists auth middleware, session storage, and client retry logic.
Recommendations prioritize a focused fix and regression tests.

output_examples.input: Request: Plan a caching layer for product search.
output_examples.output: Gemini returns a phased plan covering data flow, cache invalidation, rollout risk, and verification checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Request: Verify password reset changes before merge.
output: Summary states whether the change appears consistent with the intended behavior.
Analysis calls out missing edge cases and any sensitive data exposure.
Recommendations list manual tests and automated checks to run.

best_practices: Scope directory inputs tightly before invoking Gemini.
Review Gemini findings before changing code.
Redact secrets and sensitive customer data from prompts and diffs.
anti_patterns: Running the wrapper automatically on untrusted repositories.
Letting Gemini write final code without local review.
Passing full projects when a smaller directory is enough.

faq.question: Does this skill require Gemini CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill depends on Gemini CLI and a compatible wrapper script.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata supports Codex, Claude, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it modify files?
faq.answer: No. It delegates research and verification. The main assistant must make any edits.

faq.question: Will my code be sent outside my machine?
faq.answer: It may, depending on Gemini CLI configuration. Review privacy policies and redact sensitive data before use.

faq.question: Can I add custom roles?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes role files under `.gemini/roles/`, but only use trusted role content.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: The skill asks Gemini for a summary, file references, analysis, and recommendations.
